summary.text: Michael J. Fitzpatrick is the Republican member of the New York State Assembly for District 8, elected in 2002, and is running for re-election on the Republican and Conservative lines in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Before joining the Assembly he served on the Smithtown Town Board and spent more than 20 years in the financial services industry.

paragraphs.text: Michael J. Fitzpatrick was born in Jamaica, Queens, on April 15, 1957, and was raised in Hauppauge on Long Island.
He graduated from Hauppauge High School in 1975 and received a B.A. in business administration from St. Michael's College in Vermont in 1979.
According to Ballotpedia, his professional experience includes work as an investment associate for UBS Financial Services.
Fitzpatrick served on the Smithtown Town Board for 15 years, from 1988 through 2002.
He was elected to the Assembly on November 5, 2002.
He is the ranking minority member of the Assembly Housing Committee and also sits on the Ways and Means, Higher Education, Banks and Agriculture committees.

Fitzpatrick is a member of the Knights of Columbus and the Ancient Order of Hibernians, vice president of the New York State chapter of the Irish Legislators Society, and a past president of the board of trustees of the Cleary School for the Deaf in Nesconset.
He lives in St. James, in the Town of Smithtown, with his wife, Lorena, and they have two children.
